# Trimmed StarRocks FE /metrics payload, reproducing the exact byte layout that
# PrometheusMetricVisitor emits (StarRocks 3.5.x). Not a live capture: it is
# reconstructed from the visitor source so the interleaving below is exact.
#
# MetricRepo.collectDatabaseMetrics() loops over databases and emits table_num
# then db_size_bytes for each one, while PrometheusMetricVisitor.visit() writes
# "# HELP"/"# TYPE" only the first time it sees a metric name. The result is the
# non-contiguous layout below: every table_num sample after the first lands in a
# family the Prometheus parser types as "unknown".
# HELP starrocks_fe_table_num count of table
# TYPE starrocks_fe_table_num gauge
starrocks_fe_table_num{db_name="information_schema"} 54
# HELP starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes total size of db in bytes
# TYPE starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes gauge
starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes{db_name="information_schema"} 0
starrocks_fe_table_num{db_name="_statistics_"} 10
starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes{db_name="_statistics_"} 8192
starrocks_fe_table_num{db_name="sys"} 8
starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes{db_name="sys"} 0
starrocks_fe_table_num{db_name="analytics"} 19
starrocks_fe_db_size_bytes{db_name="analytics"} 104857600
# HELP starrocks_fe_database_num count of database
# TYPE starrocks_fe_database_num gauge
starrocks_fe_database_num 4
# Slow-lock summaries, added upstream by StarRocks/starrocks#66027 and first
# shipped in 3.5.10. Emitted by PrometheusMetricVisitor.visitHistogram(), whose
# HELP line carries an empty description.
# HELP starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms 
# TYPE starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms summary
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms{quantile="0.75"} 512.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms{quantile="0.95"} 1180.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms{quantile="0.98"} 1460.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms{quantile="0.99"} 1725.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms{quantile="0.999"} 2048.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms_sum 91230.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_held_time_ms_count 137
# HELP starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms 
# TYPE starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms summary
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms{quantile="0.75"} 88.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms{quantile="0.95"} 304.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms{quantile="0.98"} 412.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms{quantile="0.99"} 655.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms{quantile="0.999"} 903.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms_sum 20418.0
starrocks_fe_slow_lock_wait_time_ms_count 137
